entries.migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repos running `gh plate release finalize` after a Release PR merge will now automatically populate the GitHub Releases tab (latest + notes) instead of requiring manual gh release create. --apply is required for the destructive reset step (still prints the command and errors clearly if guards fail). Add the new fragment on cut.
entries.agent_notes: This closes the main automation gap from #591 (post #569 MVP). The helpers are designed to be called from release.yml too. Use --apply deliberately. Tests cover dry, exists, assets convention, guard messages. See #592 body for full ACs and planning decisions (both create+reset automated, workflow auto in follow-up, explicit simple assets).
migration_guidance: After upgrading, re-run `gh plate release finalize <last-ver>` with --apply if you want the branch reset (otherwise just the release object will be created).
The vX.Y.Z/assets/ convention is new and optional for attaching extra release artifacts.
Update any local scripts that parsed the old 'Recommended commands' output from finalize.
Status (sibling #594) will soon surface GitHub release state to detect/create success.

entries.migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repos will now have the GitHub Release object (UI, latest, rich notes from release.json) automatically created as part of the tag job for Release PRs (best-effort). The explicit `gh plate release finalize` path remains available for repair/manual use or older flows. The helper and convention are shared with the finalize path from #592.
entries.agent_notes: Reuses create_github_release + _render_release_notes + assets logic exactly (DRY). Best-effort wrapper (set +e + try/except) per #593 refinement decisions under #591. Idempotent via helper. See full refined ACs and impl notes in #593 body. Complements #592 (finalize explicit path).
migration_guidance: If you have a customized release.yml, port the new step (modeled on the validate step; uses PYTHONPATH + the plate_core.release helper).
No changes needed to .plate config or extension checks for this.
The fragment ensures this is documented in the next release notes.
Test locally with a dry Release PR merge if possible.

entries.migration_impact: None for downstream: auto repo detection (gh plate health, bootstrap, release, etc without --repo) now works for valid dotted repo names. No behavior change for standard names.
